summary: Biomass-versus-richness data in manipulated plant communities are open (Cedar Creek E120 on EDI, Jena Experiment on PANGAEA, two Dryad syntheses incl. one with functional dispersion), but they are all plant experiments, and the structural/functional diversity variable must be built from traits (TRY needs registration). No dataset pairs whole-biota 'amount of life' with structural diversity.
next_step: Pick one experiment (Jena main experiment or Cedar Creek E120), join species trait values, pre-register the diversity metric and biomass definition.
obstacles_confirmed: Data are mostly temperate grassland plants
